Notes: Minimum 8–9 months (240–270 days) if the CUA, POE, ABC transfer, and building permit proceed in parallel without appeals or denials: CUA 120 days, POE 45 days (filed after CUA approval), ABC transfer 60 days (filed after CUA and building permit are approved), building permit 60 days (plan review in parallel with CUA), DPH plan check and inspection 60 days (routed with building permit). Maximum 19 months (570 days) if the CUA or POE permit is appealed (add 30–90 days), the ABC transfer is protested or requires a PCN finding (add 60–120 days), or the building permit is delayed by incomplete plans or DPH/Fire corrections (add 60 days). The critical path is the CUA hearing (4–10 months including pre-application, environmental review, and hearing scheduling), followed by the ABC license transfer (2–5 months depending on protests and PCN process). Construction can begin after the building permit is issued, but the Health Permit and ABC license must be in hand before opening to the public.

outcomes.original: Estimated time: 240 to 570 days. Estimated government cost: $8,800 to $25,000. Notes: Minimum 8–9 months (240–270 days) if the CUA, POE, ABC transfer, and building permit proceed in parallel without appeals or denials: CUA 120 days, POE 45 days (filed after CUA approval), ABC transfer 60 days (filed after CUA and building permit are approved), building permit 60 days (plan review in parallel with CUA), DPH plan check and inspection 60 days (routed with building permit). Maximum 19 months (570 days) if the CUA or POE permit is appealed (add 30–90 days), the ABC transfer is protested or requires a PCN finding (add 60–120 days), or the building permit is delayed by incomplete plans or DPH/Fire corrections (add 60 days). Government costs: CUA $3,100 (base fee, no construction), POE $2,708, ABC Type 42 transfer $1,000–$1,600, DPH plan check $828–$1,241, DPH Health Permit $470, building permit $800–$15,000 (varies with construction valuation), plus SF business registration $55–$95, CA entity formation $70, seller's permit $0, EIN $0, food safety manager cert $100–$250, RBS training for staff ~$100–$200 total, ASCAP/BMI licenses ~$600–$5,000/year. The license transfer price (typically $0 for a Type 42 transferred from a closing bar, but brokers may charge $5,000–$20,000 depending on market availability within the Mission SUD) is not included in government costs. The critical path is the CUA hearing (4–10 months including pre-application, environmental review, and hearing scheduling), followed by the ABC license transfer (2–5 months depending on protests and PCN process). Construction can begin after the building permit is issued, but the Health Permit and ABC license must be in hand before opening to the public.
